llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a financial incentive of Rs. 50,000 to couples belonging to the SC community who opt for a simple marriage ceremony and apply within one year of marriage, provided they are Karnataka residents with family income not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh per annum.
llm_fields.eligibility: Karnataka resident; belonging to the SC community; family income not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh per annum; application submitted within one year of marriage.
